content.short: Tiexo is an all-in-one NFT marketplace and data aggregator focused on the Solana ecosystem, launched in 2021.
content.description: The Tiexo marketplace showcases NFT collections on the Solana ecosystem and was launched in 2021. It lets users explore a vast catalog—well over 14 million NFTs—and list assets across multiple marketplaces, while also enabling buying or staking NFTs. Developers can access real-time statistics on the platform or use the node operator for their programs, enabling live data and easier integration within their projects.
